hooks.prompt: The stop-hook gathered this context: {{output}}. Based on CLAUDE.md workflow guidance, decide if there's obvious follow-up work. Continue if: (1) CI is pending/running, (2) there are unprocessed PR comments (feedback_count > 0), (3) a recent push needs CI monitoring. Return {"decision": "block", "reason": "..."} to continue working, or {"decision": "approve"} to stop.
